info.title: World Health Organization Universal API
info.description: Access World Health Organization Global Health Observatory data through WHO's public OData API, including indicators, dimensions, dimension values, regions, countries, and indicator observations.

get.description: Retrieves a dimension from the World Health Organization.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: dimensionCode
parameters.description: WHO dimension code, such as REGION, COUNTRY, SEX, AGEGROUP, or WORLDBANKINCOMEGROUP.

schema.description: WHO dimension code, such as REGION, COUNTRY, SEX, AGEGROUP, or WORLDBANKINCOMEGROUP.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
